notes: The storefront preview and editable CMS project ship together as one portable Revise theme package.
The PrimeTech-owned immersive scene pack is opt-in and excluded from stock materialization; includeOwnerScenes must be explicitly enabled for the owner profile.
The theme provides page structure and presentation; inventory, customer identity, checkout, payments and fulfillment are connected by the merchant host.
The local cart and checkout screens are preview interactions only and do not create orders or collect payment.
